name: Kanzo
where_agents_run: Wherever you start them; the board runs on your Mac or Linux machine, or one shared machine on a network you trust
source_note: Checked README, license, release assets, language breakdown, and the agent-tool, storage and page code. A small, lightweight task board, not an agent manager: it starts and watches no agents. Your agents connect to it and take cards from it, and it hands each card to one agent at a time. Release 0.2.1. Not installed or run here.
